healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Assisted living and memory care communities, independent living communities, continuing care communities, and skilled nursing settings.

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Senior care, including Alzheimer’s and dementia memory care and skilled nursing.

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: Predominantly private-pay resident revenue, with smaller contributions from Medicare, Medicaid, and other third-party payers.

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Monthly resident fees that vary with assessed care needs and ancillary services.

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Large multistate network of senior living communities.

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Residents needing help with daily activities or secure memory care, and patients needing short-stay or ongoing licensed skilled nursing.

notes: Resident activity volumes and clinical quality measures remain unverified.
